description: Search Toxic Release Inventory data across facilities in a state or county for a given reporting year. Returns facility name, TRI ID, chemical name, and release quantity. Use to identify top polluters in an area or build an environmental exposure profile. Use epa_get_tri_releases for detailed release records for a single facility. TRI data lags ~18 months from the current calendar year.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive)

county.description: County name to narrow results within the state (partial match)

limit.description: Maximum number of release records to return (1–200)

year.description: Reporting year. Defaults to all available years in the state. TRI data lags ~18 months.

name: epa_search_tri_releases

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_releases_found`: No TRI records found for the given state and filters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no releases are found. Absent when releases are returned.

releases.description: TRI release records for facilities in the queried state and filters

items.description: TRI release record for a facility-chemical-year combination

chemicalName.description: Chemical name as reported to TRI

totalReleasesInLbs.description: One-time release quantity in pounds (from tri_reporting_form)

truncated.description: True when the result list was capped at the limit — more records may exist.

title: Search TRI Releases by Region
